description: This file defines a helper class 'Html' within the PhpSpreadsheet library that converts HTML strings into RichText objects, parsing HTML tags, colors, and styling for spreadsheet cell formatting.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: Helper class for converting HTML content into PhpSpreadsheet RichText objects, handling HTML tags and styles.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Resets all style and internal state variables to default values.

methods.name: toRichTextObject
methods.description: Converts an HTML string into a RichText object, parsing HTML tags and styles.

methods.name: cleanWhitespace
methods.description: Cleans up whitespace in the parsed RichText elements, trimming leading spaces and after line breaks.

methods.name: buildTextRun
methods.description: Creates a text run in the RichText object with the current style settings.

methods.name: rgbToColour
methods.description: Converts an RGB string into a hex color code.

methods.name: colourNameLookup
methods.description: Looks up a color name into its corresponding hex color code, using a predefined map.

methods.name: startFontTag
methods.description: Handles the opening of a <font> HTML tag, extracting style attributes.

methods.name: endFontTag
methods.description: Resets font-related style attributes when </font> is encountered.

methods.name: startBoldTag
methods.description: Handles the opening of <b> or <strong> tags by enabling bold style.

methods.name: endBoldTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <b> or <strong> tags, disabling bold style.

methods.name: startItalicTag
methods.description: Handles opening of <i> or <em> tags by enabling italic style.

methods.name: endItalicTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <i> or <em> tags, disabling italic style.

methods.name: startUnderlineTag
methods.description: Handles opening of <u> tags by enabling underline style.

methods.name: endUnderlineTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <u> tags, disabling underline style.

methods.name: startSubscriptTag
methods.description: Handles opening of <sub> tags, enabling subscript style.

methods.name: endSubscriptTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <sub> tags, disabling subscript style.

methods.name: startSuperscriptTag
methods.description: Handles opening of <sup> tags, enabling superscript style.

methods.name: endSuperscriptTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <sup> tags, disabling superscript style.

methods.name: startStrikethruTag
methods.description: Handles opening of <del> tags by enabling strikethrough style.

methods.name: endStrikethruTag
methods.description: Handles closing of <del> tags, disabling strikethrough style.

methods.name: breakTag
methods.description: Inserts a newline character into the current text data.

methods.name: parseTextNode
methods.description: Processes a text node, normalizing whitespace, and appending it to the current text data.

methods.name: handleCallback
methods.description: Calls the appropriate method when a specific HTML tag is opened or closed.

methods.name: parseElementNode
methods.description: Processes an HTML element node, invoking start/end style handlers and parsing its child nodes.

methods.name: parseElements
methods.description: Recursively processes child nodes of an HTML element.
